projects.title: SERT: Social Engineering Red Teaming
projects.blurb: An AI agent orchestration workflow that runs phishing-style social-engineering attacks against company employees and AI agents, exposing vulnerabilities before real attackers can exploit them.
points: Orchestrator agent summarizes every attack and compiles a report summarizing most successful phishing methods, most vulnerable employees, and recommended improvements.
This allows companies find weak links in their teams and stress-test AI agents with dangerous capabilities.
Built solo at VS Live · Microsoft AI Hackathon 2026.
projects.award: 2nd place, Best AI Agent or Workflow Automation · $1,250

projects.title: Skill Mutator
projects.blurb: Evolves LLM skills by using deterministic evaluations as signal for mutator agents.
points: Built during LLM skill mutation research with Dr. Anant Sahai (UC Berkeley).
Optimized skills across benchmarks covering code editing, SQL, data science, and logic puzzles.

projects.title: Reodite (UBC) · Student Success Tools
projects.blurb: General student success tools, all in one platform. Built to assist with degree planning, fostering community, campus engagement, student finances, and giving students a voice.
points: Web app with specific tools to access public university data.
AI Agent with access to all the tools and data for quick informed responses.

projects.title: Balancing Biped
projects.blurb: A technical demo of realistic physics-based balancing bipedal creatures.
points: Can stand on uneven ground, balance with weights stacked on top, and shrug off projectiles.
Authored an LLM skill that automates creating highly tuned balancing creatures of different physiques.

games.title: Birb
games.blurb: Platformer meets tower defense — lead enemies into cages and bullet lines while stopping bombers from destroying your power sources. Survive to round 20, with bonus rounds up to 30.
points: Built with a team of four for GMTK Game Jam 2026 (theme: Count Down): design & programming with GoatDog, art by Rob, music & sound by Tony Andriamanana.
Playable in the browser — the web version folds in post-jam feedback.

games.title: Stuck at Sea
games.blurb: A first-person shooter you play with your hands — literally. Open your hand to aim, close your fist to shoot, open it again to reload, all through webcam hand tracking built on MediaPipe.
games.jam: Illinois State University Winter Game Jam

games.title: Duality
games.blurb: A 3D puzzle platformer shooter where health and energy are one resource — every jump, shot, and puzzle solve comes at a cost. Dodge deadly lasers, leap between towering platforms, and outsmart relentless enemies.
points: Built solo in 72 hours for Mini Jam 187 (theme: Duality).

games.title: Two Toy Tanks
games.blurb: Local split-screen tank duel on randomly generated maps — three classes (Spammer, Surfer, Miner), powerups, first hit wins. Made in 12 hours for a high school game dev club tournament.
games.jam: High School Game Dev Club Tournament

games.title: Blob
games.blurb: Defend a forest island as Bob the Blob — absorb defeated slimes to grow, because your health is your mass. Made by four high schoolers in 96 hours for GMTK Game Jam 2024 (theme: Built to Scale).

games.title: Blind Arcade
games.blurb: An accessibility-first mobile arcade for the blind and visually impaired — games that need no visuals at all, built on gyroscope motion tracking, spatial audio, and haptic feedback.
points: Three arcade games: an endless runner, a first-person shooter, and a coin collector.
Published on the Google Play Store — nearly 3k downloads and over 10k views on YouTube.

jams.name: GMTK Game Jam 2026
jams.story: Four days, team of four — a platformer/tower-defense hybrid where you herd enemies into cages and bullet lines. I co-designed and programmed alongside GoatDog, with art by Rob and audio by Tony Andriamanana.

jams.name: Illinois State University Winter Game Jam
jams.story: Raise your hands in front of your webcam and survive the storm — a computer-vision-powered first-person shooter where an open hand aims, a closed fist shoots, and reopening reloads.

jams.name: Mini Jam 187
jams.story: 72 hours, solo. A platformer puzzle shooter where health and energy are one resource — every action comes at a cost.

jams.name: High School Game Dev Club Tournament
jams.story: A local split-screen tank duel with random maps, powerups, and three classes — built in about 12 hours of dev time for our club tournament.

jams.name: GMTK Game Jam 2024
jams.story: Led a team of four high schoolers through 96 hours. A roguelike top-down shooter where your health is your mass — absorb slimes to grow, shrink as you take hits.

jams.name: Mini Jame Gam #32
jams.story: 58 hours. A puzzle game about guiding a plastic bottle into a trashcan by controlling gravity itself.

jams.name: Microsoft Hunt the Wumpus Competition
jams.story: A multi-week competition to reimagine the classic. Ours became a stealth dungeon crawler where the monster tracks the noise you make.

jams.name: Mini Jame Gam #27
jams.theme: Back to the Beginning (special object: a computer)
jams.story: 58 hours. A bullet-hell shooter armed with PC parts — disks and power supplies as ammo, with one energy pool shared between firing, upgrading, and teleporting back to spawn.

jams.name: GMTK Game Jam 2023
jams.story: A top-down shooter/horror built in 48 hours and submitted 40 minutes before the deadline. You assemble a mob to hunt a monster — then the roles reverse and you play as the monster, tuned so both sides are winnable.

jams.name: Plane Flight Jam — 18 hours
jams.story: Self-imposed jam on a plane flight: Snake crossed with tower defense, where the snake collects turrets and coils them into a defense.

jams.name: Plane Flight Jam — 11 hours
jams.story: Another plane flight, another game: a Flappy-Bird-style scroller where gun recoil is your only means of movement.
